newsitem.title: CHINA: WHIMSY SAYS TO MAKE HK$35 MLN PROVISION.
newsitem.headline: WHIMSY SAYS TO MAKE HK$35 MLN PROVISION.

text.p: Whimsy Entertainment Co Ltd said on Thursday it would make a provision of HK$35 million for shortcomings relating to transactions in non-core activities in the final results due to be released on August 22.
"It is prudent to make necessary provision in respect of these transactions in the accounts for the year ended 31st March, 1997," the amusement centre operator said in a statement.
The company said the shortcomings were from transactions in the areas of investments, loans to third parties, and receivables in respect of finachising and non-core activities.
"These provisions relate to several one-off transactions and not to the core trading operations of the company," it said.
Trading in the company shares, which has suspended on Tuesday, is due to resume on Thursday.
